name: stats-details
title: Detailed Stats Cards
description: Section component displaying stats in a 3-column grid. Each card has an icon, label, value, and detailed description. On hover, the icon button fills with orange and a background image fades in. Hardcoded stat data with Unsplash images.
use: Detailed metrics or KPI sections where each stat warrants explanation and visual interest.
avoid: Reusable stat cards; data is hardcoded.
a11y: Semantic article element in each card. Icons are decorative (inside interactive boxes but no aria-labels). Text has good contrast in default state; hover state uses orange which may have contrast…
